recommendations_not_final.empirical_domain: per-fold q01~q99 for generation and OOD guard; min/max retained for audit
recommendations_not_final.minimum_support: per-feature at least 25 rows and joint strict-AND at least 12 rows in an approximately 250-row fold
recommendations_not_final.near_full: flag interval width >=80% of that fold q01~q99 span
recommendations_not_final.pair_generation: center/width or observed quantile-pair generation; never independent low/high sampling

interval_unsuitable.Aligned_bull: binary state; dominant value median share about 78%
interval_unsuitable.MACD_golden: binary sparse event; positive frequency approximately 2.8~4.8%

important_caveats: BB position must not be clipped to [0,1] before OOD checks because values outside the bands are valid.
MA relation, normalized MACD and volume ratio are not mathematically upper-bounded; hard sanity bounds require a separate policy decision.
The recommended values are implementation candidates, not finalized production constants.
